content:
incident-bot: PAGER: high-priority alert — GPU autoscaler failing to add nodes in cluster prod-us-west-2. queue growth detected on /generate endpoint. 90th latency > 5s, error spikes. Paging oncall.
oncall-ops: i'm on it, grabbing context. which nodegroup is affected?
sre-elaine: seeing repeated errors in autoscaler: "could not create nodegroup: AttachRole not permitted". looks like IAM passrole denies in logs. digging.
infra-miguel: i can confirm ASG for ng-gpu-prod-usw2 is at desired=0, max=30 but recent API calls returning 403 for iam:PassRole from cluster-autoscaler. maybe role ARN rotated? @eng-runtime can you check rollout that touched instance profile yesterday?
eng-runtime: no deploys touching infra roles in the last 48h. we did a runtime update 10h ago that changed kernel args, unrelated. sharing cluster-autoscaler logs:
prod-telemetry: "[2025-03-10T21:02:13Z] ERROR: failed to create ASG: AccessDenied: User: arn:aws:sts::...:assumed-role/cluster-autoscaler/... is not authorized to perform: iam:PassRole on resource: arn:aws:iam::...:role/RedwoodNodeRole"
support-luke: wild. customers are reporting failures to start long-running jobs. some blocking ML teams. I see ~14% increase in failed requests to /batch-embed since 21:00 UTC.
oncall-ops: can someone run `kubectl get nodes` and `kubectl get pods -n inference` to see queue/backlog state?
sre-elaine: output:

```
$ kubectl get nodes
NAME                                        STATUS   ROLES    AGE   VERSION
ip-10-0-12-34.usw2.internal                 Ready    <none>   5d    v1.26.3
ip-10-0-23-57.usw2.internal                 Ready    <none>   2d    v1.26.3
(only control-plane and non-gpu nodes)

$ kubectl -n inference get pods --no-headers | wc -l
212
$ kubectl -n inference top pods | sort -nr -k3 | head -n 15
embedding-worker-0   200m  4Gi
embedding-worker-1   190m  4Gi
... many pods Pending due to nodeSelector: "gpu: present"
```

infra-miguel: so autoscaler trying to create nodes but IAM blocks. quick mitigation: we can escalate to ops-iam to re-grant iam:PassRole to the cluster-autoscaler assumed role. i'll open a ticket and ping SSO owners. @devex-anya can we temporary set nodeSelector on some pods to run on non-gpu nodes with lower perf to reduce queue? maybe a degraded path.
devex-anya: we can fall back to CPU workers for some non-latency-sensitive langs. i'll push a canary patch to inference deployment to add toleration/affinity override for batch-embed: `tolerations: []` and nodeSelector `cpu:true` for a fraction of replicas. pushing in 2m.
eng-runtime: also spotted some nodes created but tainted with `node.kubernetes.io/unavailable:NoSchedule` coming from a bad launch-template hook. those nodes never join kubelet because kubelet cert mismatched. autoscaler then marks recent attempts as failed and backs off.
prod-telemetry: correlated events: 21:01:03 autoscaler createInstance -> 21:01:14 AWS returns LaunchTemplateVersionMismatch; 21:01:15 node created but kubelet crashloop -> pod events show `node has taint: node.kubernetes.io/unavailable:NoSchedule` and `kubelet: certificate expired`.
oncall-ops: summary so far: 1) IAM PassRole denies preventing ASG changes, 2) some LT mismatch / kubelet cert issues on newly provisioned nodes causing taint & not joining. both reduce effective capacity and cause queue growth. customer impact: degraded throughput and errors on /batch-embed and /generate. ETA for fix depends on IAM owners and possibly rolling a new launch template.
sre-elaine: immediate actions i'm executing:
- escalate to iam-admins with urgent label + runbook link
- disable cluster-autoscaler scale-down to avoid churning
- attempt manual ASG increase (if permitted) to known-good instance ids as stopgap
infra-miguel: iam-admins responded: investigated, a recent infra automation rotated the NodeRole and forgot to add PassRole to the CA role. they can add it in ~10-15m with approval from security. patch in progress.
support-luke: customers hitting failures: top 3 affected tenants: acme-ai (10% requests failing), beta-vision (heap of queued jobs, high latency), internal-ci (flake in e2e). creating incident page to collect owners.
devex-anya: i pushed canary to route 10% of batch-embed to CPU fallback. logs show immediate drop in pending pods from 212 -> 150. helpful but not full restore.
eng-runtime: while IAM patch is applied, we should also roll launch template back to last known-good version 7. i'm preparing LT rollback commands. snippet:

```
aws autoscaling update-auto-scaling-group --auto-scaling-group-name ng-gpu-prod-usw2 --launch-template LaunchTemplateId=lt-0abcde,Version=7
```

infra-miguel: i'll hold off until CA can create nodes, otherwise we'll keep hitting mismatch. iam-admins say once PassRole added, CA can successfully create instances using the current LT v8, but some v8 nodes already have kubelet cert issue. plan: let CA create nodes, mark tainted nodes for termination, and set ASG to ignore unhealthy for a minute while we let bootstrapping happen.
sre-elaine: performed `kubectl taint nodes node-12345 node.kubernetes.io/unavailable:NoSchedule-` to untaint a test node and watched kubelet come up, it then registered. but cert error persists on others. we'll cordon and drain the tainted nodes to force replacement.
prod-telemetry: metrics watch: queue size peaked at 18k pending requests at 21:05 UTC, now down to 6.2k after CPU fallback and a few successful node joins. error rate down from 14% -> 6%.
oncall-ops: timeline check: incident opened 21:01, IAM patch completion 21:20, CA started provisioning 21:22, first healthy gpu node join 21:28, queue significantly reduced 21:34. good.
sre-elaine: final mitigation steps taken:
- iam-admins added iam:PassRole to cluster-autoscaler role
- rolled tainted nodes via cordon/drain/terminate
- temporarily increased ASG max to 50 to allow burst until steady-state
- enabled CPU fallback path for batch-embed and updated routing to reduce pressure
- disabled autoscaler scale-down for 30m
support-luke: notifying affected customers with summary & ETA for full recovery. asked to escalate any urgent jobs via support channel.
infra-miguel: follow-ups: create automated check in infra pipeline to ensure PassRole present when rotating NodeRole; add LT bootstrap smoke test to detect kubelet cert mismatch early; document mitigation runbook and include playbook for manual ASG bump.
devex-anya: i'll add a degraded-mode doc for product teams on how to opt into CPU fallback gracefully.
eng-runtime: will investigate why LT v8 caused cert expiry — likely user-data or ca bundle difference. opening a ticket to block that LT from future rollouts until verified.
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED (severity: high -> mitigated). postmortem requested: please fill out the template at https://redwood.atlassian.com/INTERNAL-INCIDENTS/1750012345
sre-elaine: quick notes for postmortem: root cause = infra automation rotated NodeRole without updating cluster-autoscaler's PassRole permission + a bad launch template rollout that caused kubelet cert mismatch; contributing = autoscaler backoff behavior and no CPU fallback prior.
oncall-ops: thanks team. i'll hand off to owners for post-incident and timeline doc. +1 for follow-ups. :thumbsup
